Correct query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(homeGoals),0) AS home_goals, COALESCE(SUM(awayGoals),0) AS away_goals, COALESCE(SUM(homeGoals),0)+COALESCE(SUM(awayGoals),0) AS total_goals FROM `Match` WHERE homeTeamId=1 OR awayTeamId=1; But still same issue. We need to sum homeGoals only when homeTeamId=1, and awayGoals only when awayTeamId=1. So we can use conditional aggregation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN homeTeamId=1 THEN homeGoals END),0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN awayTeamId=1 THEN awayGoals END),0) AS total_goals FROM `Match`; That will sum correctly.
